  have hBase := AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.ProximalBPS.PolarIsometry.actual_centered_polar_isometry

      change P (g-P g)=0

    calc

                              let fV : HP0 := V0.adjoint fperp
                              B.adjoint (fperp : Lp ℝ 2 J)=HP0.subtypeL (ΓP0 fV) ∧
